find_available_intervals.title: Find available times
find_available_intervals.description: Find the start times at which a service can be booked, across one or more date-time ranges, for the given resources or every resource assigned to the service. The first step of booking: pick a start from here, then create_reservation.

ranges.description: Date-time ranges to search, each {start, end} as ISO 8601 strings.

resource_ids.description: Resources to check. Defaults to every resource assigned to the service.

resource_group_ids.description: Resource groups whose resources to check; not with resource_ids.

duration.description: Minutes that must be free from the start of an interval. Defaults to the service's.

buffer_before.description: Minutes before a booking that must be clear.

buffer_after.description: Minutes after a booking that must be clear.

parts.description: Override the service's booking parts: each {type: block|free, duration: minutes}.

spaces.description: Spaces needed; excludes group bookings without enough room.

timezone.description: IANA time zone to return dates and times in, e.g. Europe/London.

ignore_bookings.description: Booking ids to treat as not blocking time, e.g. the booking being moved.

ignore_notice_restriction.description: Ignore the organisation's and service's notice period.

ignore_service_assignment.description: Do not fail when a resource is not assigned to the service.

ignore_group_setting.description: Offer group bookings with space even when online group booking is off.

find_available_dates.title: Find available dates
find_available_dates.description: Find which days in the given ranges have at least one bookable time for a service -- for rendering a calendar before asking find_available_intervals for times on a chosen day.

ranges.description: Date-time ranges to search, each {start, end} as ISO 8601 strings.

resource_ids.description: Resources to check. Defaults to every resource assigned to the service.

resource_group_ids.description: Resource groups whose resources to check; not with resource_ids.

duration.description: Minutes that must be free from the start of an interval. Defaults to the service's.

buffer_before.description: Minutes before a booking that must be clear.

buffer_after.description: Minutes after a booking that must be clear.

parts.description: Override the service's booking parts: each {type: block|free, duration: minutes}.

spaces.description: Spaces needed; excludes group bookings without enough room.

timezone.description: IANA time zone to return dates and times in, e.g. Europe/London.

ignore_bookings.description: Booking ids to treat as not blocking time, e.g. the booking being moved.

ignore_notice_restriction.description: Ignore the organisation's and service's notice period.

ignore_service_assignment.description: Do not fail when a resource is not assigned to the service.

ignore_group_setting.description: Offer group bookings with space even when online group booking is off.

create_reservation.title: Reserve a time slot
create_reservation.description: Hold a date and time for a service (and optionally a specific resource) so it cannot be taken while the booking is completed. The hold expires after `expires_after` minutes; turn it into a booking with create_booking. Books onto a matching group booking automatically when one has space.

resource_id.description: Resource to reserve. A random assigned resource is chosen when omitted.

resource_group_ids.description: Pick the random resource from these groups.

slot_timezone.description: IANA time zone `start` is expressed in.

parts.description: Override the service's booking parts: each {type: block|free, duration: minutes}.

expires_after.description: Minutes until the hold lapses. Defaults to the organisation's setting.

max_spaces.description: Maximum spaces the resulting group booking holds.

allow_additional_spaces.description: Let other reservations join this one as a group booking.

timezone.description: IANA time zone to return dates and times in, e.g. Europe/London.

ignore_group_setting.description: Join group bookings even when online group booking is off.

output.description: The reservation; its id is the slot_id create_booking takes.

get_reservation.title: Get a reservation
get_reservation.description: Read a reservation (availability slot) by id: service, resource, start, parts, spaces and when it expires.

timezone.description: IANA time zone to return dates and times in, e.g. Europe/London.

delete_reservation.title: Release a reservation
delete_reservation.description: Delete a reservation so its time is available again. Use it when a customer abandons a booking flow.

list_bookings.title: List bookings
list_bookings.description: List bookings, filtered by start/end window, creation or update time, status, service, category, resource, customer or id, and sorted by creation, update or start time. Also the way to fetch specific bookings: pass their ids.

start.description: Id from the previous page's `next` property, to fetch the following page.

end.description: Id from the current page's `prev` property, to fetch the preceding page.

after.description: Only bookings starting at or after this ISO 8601 instant.

before.description: Only bookings ending at or before this ISO 8601 instant.

created_after.description: Only bookings created at or after this instant.

created_before.description: Only bookings created at or before this instant.

updated_after.description: Only bookings updated at or after this instant.

updated_before.description: Only bookings updated at or before this instant.

ids.description: Only bookings with these ids. Sent comma-separated.

categories.description: Only bookings whose service is in these categories; with these ids. Sent comma-separated.

services.description: Only bookings for these services; with these ids. Sent comma-separated.

customers.description: Only bookings with these customers; with these ids. Sent comma-separated.

resources.description: Only bookings with these resources; with these ids. Sent comma-separated.

return_matching_customers_only.description: With `ids`, return only matching customers on each booking.

timezone.description: IANA time zone to return dates and times in, e.g. Europe/London.

next.description: Id to pass as `start` for the next page, or null.

prev.description: Id to pass as `end` for the previous page, or null.

create_booking.title: Create a booking
create_booking.description: Turn an active reservation (from create_reservation) into a confirmed booking, adding the customers on it. Each customer needs at least profile.firstname and profile.lastname; an existing customer is matched rather than duplicated. Sends each customer a payment request unless send_payment_request is false.

customers.description: Customers to book: each {customer: {profile: {firstname, lastname, email, mobile, phone}, marketing_subscribed, custom_fields}, notes, questions, status, total_spaces, locale, timezone, booking_source}. An empty list makes an empty booking.

label.description: Label shown on the booking in the Appointedd screen.

created_source.description: Free-text name of what created the booking.

send_payment_request.description: Send each customer a payment request (default true).

timezone.description: IANA time zone to return dates and times in, e.g. Europe/London.

update_booking.title: Update a booking
update_booking.description: Change a booking: move it to another service, resource or time (via `parts`), change its capacity, label or buffers. Moving re-checks availability. send_notifications emails every customer about the change.

buffer_before.description: Minutes before the booking to keep clear.

buffer_after.description: Minutes after the booking to keep clear.

parts.description: New timing: each {label, start, end} with ISO 8601 times.

modified_source.description: Free-text name of what made the change.

send_notifications.description: Email each customer that the booking changed.

ignore_service_assignment.description: Allow a resource not assigned to the service.

ignore_service_schedule.description: Ignore the service's schedule when moving.

timezone.description: IANA time zone to return dates and times in, e.g. Europe/London.

cancel_booking.title: Cancel a booking
cancel_booking.description: Cancel a whole booking and every customer on it. To take one customer off a group booking use cancel_booking_customer instead.

source.description: Free-text name recorded as having cancelled it.

update_booking_customer.title: Update a customer on a booking
update_booking_customer.description: Change one customer's entry on a booking: notes, question answers, spaces used, or arrival status (Arrived, Complete, No Show).

customer_booking_id.description: The customer's customer_booking_id on the booking, or their customer_id.

notes.description: Notes about this customer on this booking.

questions.description: Booking-flow questions and answers: each {label, value, type: text|checkbox|dropdown|terms}.

spaces.description: Spaces this customer uses; cannot exceed what is left.

cancel_booking_customer.title: Cancel one customer on a booking
cancel_booking_customer.description: Cancel a single customer's place on a booking, leaving the booking and its other customers in place.

customer_booking_id.description: The customer's customer_booking_id on the booking -- not their customer id.

create_booking_customer_invoice.title: Invoice a customer on a booking
create_booking_customer_invoice.description: Create an invoice for one customer on a booking. Appointedd documents the body only as a `data` object, so its fields are passed through as given.

list_customers.title: List customers
list_customers.description: List the customers in the organisation's CRM, sorted by creation or name, or fetch specific ones by id.

start.description: Id from the previous page's `next` property, to fetch the following page.

end.description: Id from the current page's `prev` property, to fetch the preceding page.

ids.description: Only customers with these ids. Sent comma-separated.

next.description: Id to pass as `start` for the next page, or null.

prev.description: Id to pass as `end` for the previous page, or null.

get_customer.title: Get a customer
get_customer.description: Read one customer by id: profile (names, email, mobile, phone), tags and custom fields.

create_customer.title: Create a customer
create_customer.description: Add a customer to the CRM. First and last name are required; `mobile` is what SMS reminders go to.

update_customer.title: Update a customer
update_customer.description: Change a customer's names, email, mobile or phone, or replace their tags. Tags given here replace all existing ones.

delete_customer.title: Delete a customer
delete_customer.description: Delete a customer from the CRM. Their past bookings are not cancelled by this.

list_resources.title: List resources
list_resources.description: List resources (staff, rooms, equipment that bookings are made against), optionally only those assigned to given services.

start.description: Id from the previous page's `next` property, to fetch the following page.

end.description: Id from the current page's `prev` property, to fetch the preceding page.

ids.description: Only resources with these ids. Sent comma-separated.

services.description: Only resources assigned to at least one of these services; with these ids. Sent comma-separated.

next.description: Id to pass as `start` for the next page, or null.

prev.description: Id to pass as `end` for the previous page, or null.

update_resource.title: Update a resource
update_resource.description: Change a resource's name, email, phone or address, or replace the services it is assigned to (the list given replaces the current assignment).

services.description: Service ids to assign; replaces the current set.

delete_resource.title: Delete a resource
delete_resource.description: Delete a resource from the organisation. Check list_bookings for its upcoming bookings first.

list_resource_groups.title: List resource groups
list_resource_groups.description: List resource groups -- the sets of resources (e.g. a location's staff) availability and reservations can be narrowed to.

start.description: Id from the previous page's `next` property, to fetch the following page.

end.description: Id from the current page's `prev` property, to fetch the preceding page.

ids.description: Only resource groups with these ids. Sent comma-separated.

next.description: Id to pass as `start` for the next page, or null.

prev.description: Id to pass as `end` for the previous page, or null.

list_services.title: List services
list_services.description: List the bookable services with category, description, durations and prices, occupancy and group-booking settings. Service ids are what availability and reservations take.

start.description: Id from the previous page's `next` property, to fetch the following page.

end.description: Id from the current page's `prev` property, to fetch the preceding page.

ids.description: Only services with these ids. Sent comma-separated.

next.description: Id to pass as `start` for the next page, or null.

prev.description: Id to pass as `end` for the previous page, or null.

get_service.title: Get a service
get_service.description: Read one service by id: name, category, description, booking type, durations and prices, buffers and whether group bookings are allowed.

list_service_categories.title: List service categories
list_service_categories.description: List the categories services are grouped under.

start.description: Id from the previous page's `next` property, to fetch the following page.

end.description: Id from the current page's `prev` property, to fetch the preceding page.

ids.description: Only categories with these ids. Sent comma-separated.

next.description: Id to pass as `start` for the next page, or null.

prev.description: Id to pass as `end` for the previous page, or null.

get_service_category.title: Get a service category
get_service_category.description: Read one service category by id, with its name.
